text:
maya: Quick design review — prioritized stack ordering in the routing editor. Posting mockups in thread. TL;DR: users are getting confused by the label 'Stack' vs 'Priority', validation UX is noisy, and the preview sim doesn't surface which rule actually matched. Thoughts? thomas: +1 on renaming. 'Priority' is the word our docs use. Also the drag handle needs a stronger affordance — the thin dots are easy to miss. :point_up_2: lia: Accessibility nit: when you reorder via keyboard the focus disappears. We should announce new positions with a live region and use `aria-grabbed` or `aria-dropeffect` for clarity. Example: screen reader says "Rule 3 — moved to position 1". oliver: Copy tweak: current success badge reads "No conflicts" — ambiguous. Suggest "No conflicting rules found" or "Rules validated: no conflicts" so it's explicit. designbot: Screenshot uploaded: routing-stack-v5.png (see thread). Also ran contrast check: the gray handle ( #9b9b9b ) fails AA on light bg. sam: For the preview simulation, can we add a small trace panel that highlights which clause matched and why? Right now preview only shows final route. If it showed the matched rule and the evaluation path (e.g., inputs -> clause A true -> stop), it'd be much easier to debug. thomas: Validation messages are another pain point. Current inline: "Invalid sequence" for duplicate priorities — that's terse. My suggestion: "Priority conflict: two rules share the same priority. Make each priority unique or use auto-increment." Add a small "What's this?" link that opens the docs. maya: Mockup note — trying an inline validation pill instead of a modal. It appears below the rule row and links to the conflicting rule. Also proposing a compact trace toggle in the preview: expands to show matched path. lia: Small ARIA/code suggestion from accessibility review: ```html
Rule 3 moved to position 1
``` This should help screen readers during reordering. oliver: UX question — when a rule is auto-suggested by optimizer, where does it land? At bottom? We should surface that clearly, maybe with a blue "Suggested" badge and a tooltip explaining it's auto-generated and editable. sam: One more preview idea: show a side-by-side diff of request -> chosen route, with the matched rule highlighted. Low-fi example: small column with input fields, middle column with evaluation steps, right column final action. maya: Cool. Action items: 1) rename 'Stack' -> 'Priority' across UI (thomas), 2) implement live region + aria attributes for reorder (lia), 3) update copy for validation and success badges (oliver), 4) add preview trace mockup and suggested badge (sam), 5) address contrast on drag handle (design). I'll make a follow-up PR with updated mockups and copy. Anyone want to take any of these before EOD? thomas: I'll pick up the rename and drag handle contrast. lia: I'll prototype the live region and keyboard flow tests tomorrow morning. oliver: I'll update the copy and prepare tooltip text. sam: I'll draft the preview trace mockup. designbot: Noted. Created ticket RD-UI-4221 for contrast fix and RD-UX-4310 for preview trace. :white_check_mark: maya: Thanks all — I'll post the PR link when ready. :sparkles:
